## Exploratory Data Analysis

in what ways do the poverty rate of a census tract, the number of households receiving SNAP benefits, the number of households without a vehicle, and urban/rural classification, median income influence how many low-income people in a census tract live in a low food access area?

-   Specific to NC
-   take sample (.2\*2175 = 435) to address independence
-   took out missing values with `colSums(is.na(food_access_clean))` - only had to delete 4 obs (median fam income)

```{r}
#| label: clean-data

set.seed(123)

food_access_clean <- food_access |>
  filter(State=="North Carolina" & !is.na(MedianFamilyIncome)) |>
  convert_as_factor(Urban,County, State, LILATracts_1And10) |>
  select(Urban,
         TractSNAP,
         TractHUNV,
         LILATracts_1And10,
         PovertyRate,
         MedianFamilyIncome,
         State,
         County,
         CensusTract) |>
  slice_sample(prop = 0.2)


```

```{r}
#| label: explore-outcome
#| warning: false

food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=LILATracts_1And10)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Food Desert Indicator",
       y = "Number of Census Tracts",
       title = "Food Deserts in North Carolina By Census Tract",
       subtitle = "low income and low access to supermarket areas") 

# find proportion
food_access_clean |>
  count(LILATracts_1And10) |>
  mutate(prop = n/nrow(food_access_clean))

```

```{r}
#| label: explore-preds
#| warning: false

# Urban, TractSNAP, TractHUNV,PovertyRate

# explore Urban
p1<-food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=Urban)) +
  geom_bar(bins=25) +
  labs(x = "Urban Indicator", y = "Count")

# explore TractSNAP
p2<-food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=TractSNAP)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=25) +
  labs(x = "Number of housing units receiving SNAP benefits in a tract", y = "Count")

# explore TractHUNV
p3<-food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=TractHUNV)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=25) +
  labs(x = "Number of housing units without a vehicle in a tract", y = "Count")

# explore PovertyRate
p4<-food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=PovertyRate)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=25) +
  labs(x = "Poverty Rate in a tract", y = "Count")

# explore MedianFamilyIncome
food_access_clean |>
  ggplot(aes(x=MedianFamilyIncome)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=25) +
  labs(x = "Median Family Income in a tract", y = "Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar())

(p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4)
```

```{r}
#| label: summary-stats

summary(food_access_clean[c("PovertyRate", 
                            "TractSNAP", 
                            "TractHUNV", 
                            "MedianFamilyIncome"
                            )])
```

```{r}
#| label: mlr

glm_food_access <- glm(LILATracts_1And10 ~ 
                      Urban +
                      TractSNAP +
                      TractHUNV +
                      MedianFamilyIncome +
                      PovertyRate,
                    data = food_access_clean,
                    family = "binomial")

tidy(glm_food_access) |>
  kable(digits=3)

```
